q: Which great city did God send the prophet Jonah to preach against?
why: Its wickedness had come up before God.
quote: Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it

q: Instead of obeying God's call to Nineveh, where did Jonah try to run?
why: He tried to get away from the LORD.
quote: Jonah, however, got up to flee to Tarshish

q: What did the LORD send on the sea while Jonah was running away?
why: The ship was about to break apart.
quote: such a violent storm arose that the ship was in danger of breaking apart.

q: During the storm at sea, what was Jonah doing below deck?
why: The captain had to wake him up.
quote: where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.

q: How did the sailors find out Jonah was the cause of the storm?
why: The lot fell on Jonah.
quote: So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

q: During the storm, what did Jonah tell the sailors to do to calm the sea?
why: Jonah knew the storm was his fault.
quote: and cast me into the sea, so it may quiet down for you.

q: What did the LORD appoint to swallow Jonah in the sea?
why: God saved Jonah's life this way.
quote: Now the LORD had appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah

q: How long was Jonah inside the belly of the great fish?
why: Jesus later spoke of this sign.
quote: and Jonah spent three days and three nights in the belly of the fish.

q: When Jonah finally preached in Nineveh, how did the people respond?
why: Everyone put on sackcloth.
quote: And the Ninevites believed God. They proclaimed a fast and dressed in sackcloth

q: When God spared the city of Nineveh, how did Jonah feel?
why: Jonah did not want God to show them mercy.
quote: Jonah, however, was greatly displeased, and he became angry.

q: After preaching to Nineveh, where did Jonah sit to watch what would happen?
a: In a shelter east of the city
why: He waited to see if the city would be destroyed.
quote: Then Jonah left the city and sat down east of it, where he made himself a shelter

q: Outside Nineveh, what did God make grow to give Jonah shade?
why: Jonah was very pleased with it.
quote: So the LORD God appointed a vine, and it grew up to provide shade over Jonah’s head

q: What did God send to make Jonah's shade plant wither?
why: The plant died the next day.
quote: God appointed a worm that attacked the plant so that it withered.

q: After Jonah's shade plant withered, what beat down on his head?
why: Jonah grew faint.
quote: and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint

q: At the end of Jonah's story, what did God say He cared about?
why: God cares even for Israel's enemies.
quote: So should I not care about the great city of Nineveh

q: From which port did Jonah board a ship to run from God?
why: He paid the fare to sail for Tarshish.
quote: He went down to Joppa and found a ship bound for Tarshish.

q: In the storm on Jonah's ship, what did the frightened sailors throw overboard first?
why: They tried to lighten the load.
quote: And they threw the ship’s cargo into the sea to lighten the load.

q: When the sailors asked who he was, what did Jonah say he was?
why: He worshiped the God who made sea and land.
quote: “I am a Hebrew,” replied Jonah.

q: What happened when the sailors threw Jonah into the sea?
why: The sailors then feared the LORD.
quote: and the raging sea grew calm.

q: Where was Jonah when he prayed to the LORD his God?
why: He cried out to God from the deep.
quote: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God

q: What did the great fish do when the LORD commanded it?
why: Jonah got a second chance.
quote: and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.

q: What warning did Jonah proclaim in Nineveh?
a: Forty days and Nineveh will fall
wrong: Repent or the sea will rise
why: He walked through the city calling it out.
quote: Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned!

q: When the king of Nineveh heard Jonah's warning, what did he do?
why: Even the king humbled himself.
quote: covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

q: When God saw Nineveh turn from its evil ways, what did He do?
why: God shows mercy to those who repent.
quote: He relented from the disaster He had threatened to bring upon them.

q: Why did Jonah say he had fled toward Tarshish in the first place?
wrong: He was afraid of the sea
why: He did not want Nineveh to be spared.
quote: I knew that You are a gracious and compassionate God

q: Who was the father of the prophet Jonah?
why: The book opens with his name.
quote: Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah son of Amittai

q: How long a journey was it to cross the great city of Nineveh?
why: It was an exceedingly great city.
quote: requiring a three-day journey.

q: How many people did God say lived in Nineveh who could not tell right hand from left?
why: There were many cattle as well.
quote: which has more than 120,000 people

q: What kind of wind did God send on Jonah after his shade plant withered?
why: Jonah wished to die.
quote: God appointed a scorching east wind

q: In the king of Nineveh's decree, who had to go without food or water?
why: The whole city fasted.
quote: Let no man or beast, herd or flock, taste anything at all.
